The last of the Tiyanki in the [tiyanki_system.GetName] system have been exterminated by the [tiyanki_killer.GetName]. With their ancient breeding grounds scoured, the Tiyanki will no longer be able to reproduce for the first time in galactic history.

texts.zh:
[tiyanki_system.GetName]中的最后一只缇扬奇已被[tiyanki_killer.GetName]击杀。由于它们的古老繁殖地已被净化，缇扬奇再也不能继续繁殖了，这是星系历史上的第一次。

texts.en:
The last of the Tiyanki in the [tiyanki_system.GetName] system have been exterminated by the [tiyanki_killer.GetName]. With their ancient breeding grounds scoured, the Tiyanki will no longer be able to reproduce for the first time in galactic history.

With all known Tiyanki outside of [tiyanki_system.GetName] having already been hunted down, today marks the end of their species. After having roamed the galaxy for hundreds of millions of years, the Tiyanki are now extinct.

texts.zh:
[tiyanki_system.GetName]中的最后一只缇扬奇已被[tiyanki_killer.GetName]击杀。由于它们的古老繁殖地已被净化，缇扬奇再也不能继续繁殖了，这是星系历史上的第一次。

有传闻称尚有一只古老的缇扬奇族母逍遥在外。不论是否为真，从今天起，缇扬奇作为一个物种只能被看作已经灭绝。
texts.en:
The last of the Tiyanki in the [tiyanki_system.GetName] system have been exterminated by the [tiyanki_killer.GetName]. With their ancient breeding grounds scoured, the Tiyanki will no longer be able to reproduce for the first time in galactic history.

There are rumored sightings of an ancient Tiyanki Matriarch that yet remains at large. Whether true or not, after today the Tiyanki - as a species - can only be considered extinct.

texts.zh:
很久很久以前，即使在我们国家还如日中天的时候，缇扬奇已经被视作古老的生物了……现在我听说一批[Root.GetSpeciesName]舰船最近屠杀了这些手无寸铁的生物，使得缇扬奇彻底灭绝。

你们卑微的[Root.GetSpeciesName]大脑能理解自己干的事情吗？你们对自己无情的举动从星系中窃取走的东西有最起码的理解吗？
texts.en:
Even when our empire was at the height of its power, eons ago, the Tiyanki were considered ancient, and now... now I am told that a bunch of [Root.GetSpeciesName] WHELPS recently slew the last of the defenseless creatures, rendering them extinct.

Can your feeble [Root.GetSpeciesName] brains comprehend what you have done? Do you have even the slightest notion of what your callous actions have stolen from this galaxy?

label.en: We... we didn't mean for this to happen.

label.zh: 缇扬奇的时代结束了，你们也一样。
label.en: Like you, their time had passed.

The last known Tiyanki was recently hunted down and killed by the [tiyanki_killer.GetName] in the [tiyanki_system.GetName] system. These spacefaring life forms, who were far older than any currently existing empire, are believed to have roamed the galaxy for hundreds of millions of years. Today marks the end of their storied history.

There are rumored sightings of an ancient Tiyanki Matriarch that yet remains at large. Whether true or not, after today the Tiyanki - as a species - can only be considered extinct.

summary.text:
# 缇扬奇母星系已净化 / Tiyanki Home System Scoured

- 分类 Category：C8 银河轶事 / Galactic miscellany

## 如何开始 How it starts

367：消灭蒂扬奇家园系统的全部守卫舰队时（全局旗标 tiyanki_home_cleared，一次），告知有情报的人类玩家；370：最后一只蒂扬奇（所有蒂扬奇国家都没有舰船）被杀时（全局旗标 tiyanki_extinct，一次）。

367: when all guard fleets of the Tiyanki home system are destroyed (global flag tiyanki_home_cleared, once) the human players with intel are informed; 370: when the last Tiyanki is killed (no Tiyanki country has ships; global flag tiyanki_extinct, once).

## 剧情脉络 Story outline

367 / 370 都有四个立场选项（世人应当感谢我们 / 不可原谅的罪行 / 好走不送 / 可惜），选项因是否杀手本人和有无“蒂扬奇害虫控制”决议而异。若有衰落帝国存在，20天后 371“来电”：衰落帝国对蒂扬奇灭绝的反应。

Both 367 and 370 offer four stances (the galaxy should thank us / an unforgivable crime / good riddance / unfortunate), varying by whether one is the killer and by the Tiyanki Pest Control resolution. If a Fallen Empire exists, 20 days later 371 "Incoming Transmission" gives its reaction to the extinction.

## 分支与结局 Branches and outcomes

四个立场选项；371 三个回应。

Four stances; three replies in 371.

## 条件与文明差异 Conditions and variants

正文因是否仍有年迈的蒂扬奇（elderly_tiyanki）而不同。

The text differs by whether elderly Tiyanki remain.
